data.title: 艾莉莎 · 书页里的日出
data.description: 艾莉莎靠在窗边的椅背上，把读了一半的小说朝窗光挪了挪。书签还搭在手指上，她又向后翻了一页。蓝色丝睡衫的白滚边落到手腕，膝上盖着一条折好的薄毯。
data.action: 坐在椅子上用指尖翻书，膝上覆着薄毯
data.lighting: 窗光从桌边缓慢移到书页内侧
data.camera: 侧面中景，书和手腕入镜
data.promptProse: Alya sits in an armchair by the window with a folded blanket across her lap. A bookmark rests across the fingers of the hand that holds the paperback steady while her other hand turns a page. The morning light catches the white piping along one sleeve.
data.animaCaption: A folded blanket covers her lap while the light reaches the page her fingertip is turning.
